organization-invitations-conditions.subtitles: and discover brave new sea routes of solidarity, where others see hopeless horizons
organization-invitations-conditions.text-p1: Still finding our sea legs, but we're proud to reclaim the digital waters. Our adversary: the harsh sea of reality.
organization-invitations-conditions.text-p2: Our first journeys lead us to refugees from Ukraine. We want to help them online not only in emergency to reach safe harbor as quickly as possible, but to weave new nets together that transform shipwrecked souls back into bold captains who courageously take the helm even in rough waters.
organization-invitations-conditions.text-p3: As dedicated helpers, we are happy if you join us in shaping We Care in our still small harbor. Together with smart technologies, we are finding new ways to help people in need quickly and sustainably, and to overcome bureaucratic hurdles.
